summary: Validated public storefront, product filtering/detail/cart, checkout email validation, admin authentication/dashboard/settings, and mobile rendering. Four API regression tests and all focused browser checks passed.

critical.issue: Inventory check and decrement are separate operations for each line item; concurrent orders can oversell stock and a later-line conflict can leave earlier lines decremented without an order.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' while allow_credentials is false; this does not satisfy the auth playbook requirement for explicit origins and credentialed auth if cookie sessions are expected.
No brute-force lockout after five failed attempts was observed in the implementation/playbook; bearer token auth is used and no httpOnly cookie is set.

integration_issues.issue: AdminPanel fetches have no catch/error state; an expired or invalid token can leave the workspace empty without a user-facing error or redirect.
Product detail request errors are swallowed and the page remains on Loading laptop indefinitely.

action_items: Make order inventory reservation atomic (or use a transaction/rollback strategy) to prevent overselling and partial decrements.
Add explicit CORS origins and implement the intended auth session policy, including lockout if required.
Add admin API error handling with expired-token redirect and visible error state; show a product-detail error state instead of infinite loading.
critical_code_review_comments: The checkout stock update loop is not atomic under concurrent requests and can partially mutate inventory before returning 409.
Admin and product-detail API calls swallow exceptions, violating the required user-facing error-state behavior.
seed_data_creation: Created and archived one TEST_ product through the authenticated admin API; no persistent active test data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public products had two available units at UI test time because earlier order activity consumed seeded stock. Re-run concurrent order and auth-policy checks after fixes.
rca of the issue: The order race comes from find_one stock validation followed later by independent update_one operations without a transaction or reservation document. Frontend hangs occur because axios catch handlers are omitted or empty in ProductDetail and AdminPanel data loading.
